name: Icon
summary: The handful of marks a page needs most, drawn in CSS out of borders and pseudo-elements. The library ships no icon font, so every glyph here is a shape.
summaryZh: 页面最常用的那几个记号,用边框和伪元素画出来。库里没有图标字体,所以这里的每个字形都是形状。

variants.name: Check
variants.note: The tick, drawn from two borders and a turn — the same drawing the checkbox uses.

variants.name: Close
variants.note: The cross, two bars over each other.

variants.name: Dot
variants.note: A filled circle. It is the smallest mark the set has.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: The small glyph, at the caption size.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default glyph, at the body size. It needs no modifier class.

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the mark, for the case where the icon carries meaning on its own. An icon with a label is announced as an image; an icon without one is hidden from the screen reader.
props.descriptionZh: 这个记号的名字,用在图标自己就承载语义的时候。有名字的图标会被当作图片播报,没有名字的图标对读屏是隐藏的。

slots.name: default
slots.description: The glyph inside the frame. The library draws its own shapes from the `name` prop; a glyph brought here takes their place, so the two never sit on top of each other.
slots.descriptionZh: 方框里的图形。库自己按 `name` 画出形状;放进来的图形会取代它们,两者不会叠在一起。

a11y.notes: An icon is a shape and says nothing by itself, so it is hidden from the screen reader by default. When it is the only thing in a button, that button needs an accessible name of its own. When the icon is the message — a close mark that stands for “dismiss” — give it a label: the wrapper then exposes it as role="img" with that name, and the shape is announced instead of skipped.
a11y.notesZh: 图标是个形状,自己不说话,所以默认对读屏是隐藏的。当按钮里只有它一个东西时,那个按钮得自己有个可访问名称。当图标本身就是那句话 —— 一个代表“关闭”的叉 —— 就给它一个名字:封装会把它作为 role="img" 带着这个名字播报,这个形状就被念出来,而不是被跳过。

examples.title: The marks
examples.description: Every mark in the set, each drawn from borders and pseudo-elements. They take the colour of the text they sit in, because an icon that chose its own colour would be a second visual system.
examples.descriptionZh: 这一套里的每个记号,都由边框和伪元素画出来。它们取所在文字的颜色,因为一个自己挑颜色的图标就成了一套单独的视觉系统。

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: The glyph is one em square, so it is as big as the text it sits in. The size changes the type size it is measured against.
examples.descriptionZh: 字形是一个 em 见方的盒子,所以它跟所在的文字一样大。尺寸改的是它用来衡量的字号。

examples.title: With a name
examples.description: An icon that carries the message on its own is given a name, and it is announced as an image with that name. An icon beside a word stays hidden, because the word already says it.
examples.descriptionZh: 自己就承载那句话的图标要给它一个名字,它会被当作带着这个名字的图片播报。图标旁边已经有文字的仍然隐藏,因为那句话已经说过了。
examples.markup: Running

notes: The glyphs are drawn, not typed. A character would have to be in the markup, and a font would have to be loaded, and both put the shape of the mark in the document instead of in the theme — where the weight, the colour and the size are decided. Drawn here, the same seven marks work in every mood, and a mark that sits in a button takes the button's own colour.
notesZh: 这些字形是画出来的,不是打出来的。用字符就得写进标记里,用字体就得加载字体,而这两种做法都把记号的形状放到了文档里,而不是放在决定线宽、颜色和大小的主题里。画出来之后,同样这七个记号在每套 mood 里都成立,而待在按钮里的记号会取按钮自己的颜色。
